hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# ============================= # Verbosity / logging controls # ============================= LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
AWS_CLI_EXTRA=() if [[ "${VERBOSE_AWS:-0}" == "1" ]]; then AWS_CLI_EXTRA+=(--debug) log "AWS CLI debug logging ENABLED" fi
# ============================= # Config (override via env) # ============================= ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
ASSUME_OUT="${ASSUME_OUT:-assume-role-output.json}" DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR:-data}"
: "${datasetRef:?datasetRef is required}" : "${api:?api is required}"
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"
log "Dataset Ref : $datasetRef" log "S3 Bucket : $S3_BUCKET" log "Data Dir : $DATA_DIR" log "Assume Role ARN : $ROLE_ARN" log "Role Session Name : $ROLE_SESSION_NAME" log "Assume Duration : ${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS}s"
# ============================= # Cleanup # ============================= cleanup() { log "Cleaning up temporary credentials" unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN rm -f "$ASSUME_OUT" } trap cleanup EXIT
# ============================= # Prereqs # ============================= need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
log "Validating prerequisites" need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need csvgrep need java need curl log "Prerequisites OK"
# ============================= # Assume role (one time) # ============================= log "Assuming role: $ROLE_ARN (session=$ROLE_SESSION_NAME, duration=${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS}s)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" \ > "$ASSUME_OUT"
log "Parsing temporary credentials" export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$ASSUME_OUT")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$ASSUME_OUT")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$ASSUME_OUT")" log "Role assumed successfully"
# ============================= # Pull inputs # ============================= log "Downloading inputs from S3" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv" \ "${DATA_DIR}/Managed_Inputs.csv" --no-progress "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" \ "${DATA_DIR}/studies_metadata.json" --no-progress "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv" \ "${DATA_DIR}/columnMeta.csv" --no-progress "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" log "Inputs downloaded"
# Drop creds before processing locally (keeps existing behavior) unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN log "Dropped temporary credentials for local processing"
# ============================= # Build TSV for safe reading # ============================= inputs_tsv="inputs.tsv" log "Building TSV: $inputs_tsv" csvcut -c "Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" "${DATA_DIR}/Managed_Inputs.csv" \ | csvformat -T \ > "$inputs_tsv"
if [[ ! -s "$inputs_tsv" ]]; then error "inputs.tsv not created or empty" exit 1 fi log "TSV created: $inputs_tsv ($(wc -l < "$inputs_tsv") lines)"
# ============================= # Main loop # ============================= log "Scanning inputs for datasetRef match: $datasetRef"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r study_id study_type data_ready data_processed; do [[ -z "${study_id:-}" ]] && continue
if [[ "$study_id" != "$datasetRef" ]]; then continue fi
log "Matched study_id=$study_id (study_type=${study_type:-}, data_ready=${data_ready:-}, data_processed=${data_processed:-})"
mkdir -p "${study_id}/output"
log "Normalizing columnMeta.csv" csvformat -u 3 -z 524288000 "${DATA_DIR}/columnMeta.csv" > "${DATA_DIR}/columnMeta_normalized.csv" log "Normalized columnMeta written: ${DATA_DIR}/columnMeta_normalized.csv"
log "Subsetting studies metadata for study_identifier=$study_id" jq '[.bio_data_catalyst[] | select(."study_identifier"=="'"${study_id}"'")]' \ "${DATA_DIR}/studies_metadata.json" > "${study_id}/subset_metadata.json" log "Subset metadata written: ${study_id}/subset_metadata.json"
log "Filtering columnMeta for study prefix and excluding Peoria" csvgrep -z 524288000 \ -c 1 \ --regex "^\\\\${study_id,,}\\\\" \ "${DATA_DIR}/columnMeta_normalized.csv" \ | csvgrep -z 524288000 \ -c 1 \ --invert-match \ --regex "Peoria" \ > "${study_id}/subset_columnmeta.csv" log "Subset columnMeta written: ${study_id}/subset_columnmeta.csv"
log "Generating dataset input files" java -jar jars/DatasetInputFileGenerator.jar --subsetDir "./${study_id}/" --ref "${study_id}"
log "Generating concept input files" java -jar jars/ConceptInputFileGenerator.jar --subsetDir "./${study_id}/" --ref "${study_id}"
# Re-export creds for S3 + API calls (keeps existing behavior) log "Re-exporting temporary credentials for S3 and API calls" export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$ASSUME_OUT")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$ASSUME_OUT")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$ASSUME_OUT")"
log "Cleaning existing S3 CSVs under newDictionary/${study_id}/" aws s3 rm "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/newDictionary/${study_id}/" \ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}"
log "Uploading generated CSVs to s3://${S3_BUCKET}/newDictionary/${study_id}/" aws s3 cp "./${study_id}/output/" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/newDictionary/${study_id}/" \ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' --no-progress \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN log "Dropped temporary credentials before local API uploads"
log "Uploading datasets.csv to API" curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/datasets.csv" \ "${api}/dataset/csv" || exit 255
log "Uploading consents.csv to API" curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/consents.csv" \ "${api}/consent/csv?datasetRef=${study_id}" || exit 255
log "Uploading concepts.csv to API" curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/concepts.csv" \ "${api}/concept/csv?datasetRef=${study_id}" || exit 255
log "Completed processing for study_id=$study_id" done < "$inputs_tsv"
log "Job finished successfully"
